Question 1
```{r}
age <- c(15, 28, 32, 36, 27, 18, 52, 39, 42, 29, 35, 31, 27, 22, 37, 34, 19, 20, 57, 49, 50, 37, 46, 25, 17, 12, 42, 53, 41, 51, 35, 24, 33, 8)
age

length(age) 
1/age
new_age <- c(age, 0, age)
new_age

min(age)
max(age)
```
#c. new age creates a new vector,  this combines both age and the number 0 and the age again. in sum the size of new_age becomes double

Question 2
```{r}
rep(c("A","B"), each = 2)
```
#each repeats each individual elements
#times repeats the entire sequence

Question 3
```{r}
seq(1, 20, by = 2)
seq(1, 20, length.out = 5)
```
#by produces a space each unit apart. When doing intervals, like generating odd numbers
#length.out specifies the total count of numbers. When endpoints are fixed
